scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Hey hey. I don't have time for chit-chat, I'm a pretty busy guy. There's all these Merchants working hard to become Blacksmiths.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Wait a minute, I think I've met you before.
Ummm.....

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Are you the one who broke my weapon and ran away? Or are you the one who tortured me so that I'd forge a weapon for you? Why can't I remember?

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
.......
I can't remember who you are for the life of me. Is this deja vu?

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Argh!! This is really bugging me! But still, I can sense that there's something special about you. Oh well, whatever. Have a good day~

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Welcome!
We are Workers of Steel,
the Blacksmith Guild.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
We pour the fervor
and passion of our souls into
our craft. Our skills of melting metal into new weapons
and tools is truly a form of art!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
You... look like a stranger. But somehow it seems that you're related to our guild. Haha~
Am I right?

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Oh~
what a very
pretty lady!
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: First, you must become a Merchant before you can become a Blacksmith. Go to the city of Alberta to learn the Merchant trade.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Oh, are you interested in having a weapon forged? I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I actually have a lot of business to attend to.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Oh...
There's not much we can offer you here. And you can't really help out around here unless you know how to make stuff...

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Oh? What's a magic user doing here? I'm surprised. Usually this kind of rough work is beneath you intellectual types.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Oh! Am I correct in assuming you're a member of the Clergy? Would you please bless me before you leave!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
I'm sorry...
But there really isn't anything for you to steal here. Well, there are the Daggers we keep in the back, but...

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
So how's the pharmacy business going on recently?
Well, my forging business does not seem to grow any longer.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Oh! Long time no see.
Have you come to purchase supplies from Christopher? These days I'm stuck behind this desk. My body's itching to strike the ol' anvil.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Why don't you stop struggling
to make zeny as a Merchant and
join the elite Blacksmith class?
If you're interested, fill out this application with your name
and Job Level.
Fill out Application.
What are the requirements?
Um, I need to think about it.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Looks like you
meet the Job Level
Requirement.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: You see, we don't accept just anybody into our guild. First, we only accept experienced Merchants with a true desire to become great Blacksmiths. Let's see...
^3355FF*Shuffling of papers*^000000

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
One of our Blacksmiths in Einbech, ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 has sent us word that he's short on help. Your first test of character will be to help him out.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Be careful
and good luck!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Hmmm, it seems that you lack experience as a Merchant. We require that you are at least Job Level 40, you see.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: I feel bad turning you away after you've come so far, but rules are rules. Sorry to disappoint you, but we'll welcome you back once you're ready.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: You want to know our requirements? First, you need to have Job Level 40 or higher as a Merchant. Second, you need to pass a test that will be given by the Blacksmith Guild.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
The test may consist of difficult tasks, but it's definitely not impossible. You will need to deliver certain items to different areas around the world
to complete the test.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Well, I hope
to see you again.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
You haven't left yet?
Go to Einbech and find ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000. Finish helping him out, and when you're done, come back to me.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Was the work you did for ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 to your liking? He's known for being pretty exacting...

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Great job!!
You have passed
the first test...

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Hm? You look surprised.
I guess you didn't know that there's more than one test. 
Haha, but don't worry, you are not going to travel that far.
Please go talk to the guildsman inside the building for more details about your next test.
I want to change my job quickly! But...oh well.
Grrr! Enough is enough!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but I'm sure you understand, right? We can't just casually accept anybody into
our guild!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
If we don't keep our standards,
we won't be able to maintain the respectability of the Blacksmith Guild!
We can't embarass our guild in this manner! *Ahem* Anyway, you talk to the guildsman inside the building now.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Are you saying you're going
to quit the application process? That's an insult to our guild!
Get out of here! With that kind of attitude, you can forget becoming a member of the Blacksmith Guild!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
You have no spirit!
If you can't endure this, you'll never be a Blacksmith!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Um? Haven't you talk to the guildsman yet?
If you haven't, I suggest you to do so as soon as possible.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
You are on a riding pet, so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text: Excellent, I can tell by the twinkle in your eye that you were successful. I can now bestow upon you the gift of the smithing, the art of the Blacksmith.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Always remember that we are creators, and artists over metals. Be wary that you do not fall into the pitfalls of selfishness
and greed.

scripts.speaker: Altiregen
scripts.text:
Here is a little
gift to mark the
beginning of your
life as a Blacksmith.
Congratulations!!!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hello there!
I'm ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000,
a Blacksmith by trade.
Nice to meet you!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Oh ho ho!
You're a Merchant!
Excellent! I was
in need of some help!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
But, of course,
I wouldn't bother you
if you're busy. Go along
your way if you must~

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
After all...
I should know
how it's like
to be busy~

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Am I correct in assuming you are the help sent by the Blacksmith Guild? There aren't many trustyworthy people I can hire to help me, so I'm always
short on help.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm, in any case,
you are the help that was sent, right? Okay, I have some work for you that must be handled
right away!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: Some time ago, I had a boy working for me who had no experience and bought the wrong supplies! It was terrible...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: Anyone would hate to lose money through a foolish mistake like that. However, I have a slightly more difficult job for you.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: However, I want to make sure that you have some basic knowledge as a Merchant. I'd like to ask you some questions, if that's okay.
Yes.
Um, can I have some time to prepare?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
So, have you
studied a little
more this time?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
I admit that it's pretty unreasonable to expect anyone to get a perfect score the first time around, so I'll give you
a little break...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
You can miss
one problem!
Alright, let's start
with the questions~

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
1. Which one of the following regions is matched incorrectly
with its specialty item?
Morocc - Thief Clothes
Alberta - Two Hand Axe
Comodo - Berserk Potion
Alberta - Swordmace

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
2. What status can
be inflicted with the
^8E6B23Hammer Fall^000000 skill?
Stun
Blind
Silence
Sleep

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
3. Which one of the following skills cannot be performed
by a Merchant?
Vending
Discount
Overcharge
Increase AGI

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
4. Where can you find a store
that sells Blue Gemstones?
Alberta
Morocc
Geffen
Prontera

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
5. Where is the
Tool Dealer
located in Geffen?
8 o'clock direction from the town square
11 o'clock direction from the town square
6 o'clock direction from the town square
5 o'clock direction from the town square

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
6. Which weapon
cannot be used
by a Merchant?
Stiletto
Ring Pommel Saber
Chain
Bible

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
7. Which one of the following
has the highest defense rate?
Panties
Mink Coat
Wooden Mail
Silk Robe

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
8. For Level 3 weapons,
what is the ^8E6B23Safe^000000 limit
for upgrading?
up to + 3
up to + 4
up to + 5
up to + 6

9. What item
can be made using
the ^8E6B23Trunks^000000 item?
Sakkat
Ghost Bandana
Majestic Goat
Antler

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
10. The most important
part of being a Merchant is...?
Credit
Integrity
Money
Rhetoric

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: 1. Among the following cities, which one is not correctly matched with its specialty?
Al De Baran - Yggdrasil Leaf
Alberta - Hammer
Comodo - Berserk Potion
Al De Baran - Hammer

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
2. How much Zeny
is one Jellopy worth?
1 Zeny
2 Zeny
3 Zeny
4 Zeny

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
3. What is required
for a Merchant to use
the ^8E6B23Vending^000000 Skill?
Must have a Cart.
Must have items to sell.
Must be wielding a weapon.
Must be wearing armor.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
4. Where can you
change your Job to
become a Merchant?
Alberta
Morocc
Geffen
Prontera

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
5. Where is the
Weapons Dealer
located in Morocc?
7 o'clock from the town's center
11 o'clock from the town's center
6 o'clock from the town's center
5 o'clock from the town's center

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
6. What weapon
can a Merchant
not use?
Main Gauche
Claymore
Chain
Two handed Axe

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
7. Which one of the following
has the highest defense rate?
Panties
Mink Coat
Wooden Mail
Silk Robe

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
8. For Level 3 weapons,
what is the ^8E6B23Safe^000000 limit
for upgrading?
up to + 3
up to + 4
up to + 5
up to + 6

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
9. What monster does
NOT drop Iron Ore?
Chon Chon
Steel Chon Chon
Zerom
Anolian

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
10. What is most
important to a Merchant?
Rhetoric
Credit
Money
Experience

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: Umm. You did a good job!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Let's see...your score is...{0} points.
Oh ho ho~
You'll have
no problem
with this score!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Let's see...your score is...{0} points.
.............

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
I will entrust you with a job!
Give me a little time to make the necessary arrangements.
When you get back, I'll be ready!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
How do I say this?
How did you fail again?!
If you plan to perform your duties in this manner, I can't trust you with any kind of job...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...
It pains me to say this, but it seems you need to study a little more. You can never be
a Blacksmith with
this score!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Ah, of course I don't mind if you came back a little later. Being prepared prevents disasters
later, after all. No harm in
being careful~

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...
Now, where were
those order request forms...

^3355FF*Shuffling of Papers*
*Rustling of Papers*^000000

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Oh! Here it is!
This is order that
has been delayed
the most...
Heh heh~

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Well, to make
this you will need...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: Collecting these items will be your test. Coincidentally, it's also a bit of a good way for me to save money. I'll repeat what you'll need to bring back to me...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Okay~
Good luck
on your first job!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Ah, you're back!
Did you bring
everything that
I requested?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wait...
Didn't I tell you
to get 3 Steel?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Oh, I guess it was
two after all. Let's see...
Yeah, you got everything!
Now, just give me a second.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: Oh, you should make sure that you are not carrying ^FF0000more than one {0}^000000, you should really only have an {1} that you bought from an NPC shop in your inventory.
Oh, could you give me a second?
Oh, I brought what you asked for.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmmm, it would be
a good idea to put the
rest of your items
in Kafra Storage.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Okay.
Great~!!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: ^3355FF*Crash Crash!*^000000

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wooooo~~~
All done...
Okay, now take this to ^8E6B23Baisulist^000000 in Geffen of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Simply deliver it and bring me the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wooooo~~~
All done...
Okay, now take this to ^8E6B23Wickebine^000000 in Morocc of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Simply deliver it and bring me the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wooooo~~~
All done...
Okay, now take this to ^8E6B23Krongast^000000 in Lighthalzen. Simply deliver it and bring me the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wooooo~~~
All done...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wooooo~~~
All done...
Okay, now take this to ^8E6B23Bismarc^000000 in Hugel. Simply deliver this and bring back the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Wooooo~~~
All done...
and don't forget
the receipt!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
This is not a normal
Arc Wand! Look closely
at the handle...

^3355FFThe handle reads:
'Super Arc Wand
of Geschupenschte
Mark 2.' It does seem
to have a completely

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Anyway, take this
to ^8E6B23Baisulist^000000 in Geffen of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
and don't forget
the receipt!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
This is not a normal
Gladius! Look closely
at the handle...

^3355FFThe handle reads:
'Super Gladius
of Geschupenschte
Mark 2.' It does seem
to have a completely
different feel.^000000

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Anyway, take this
to ^8E6B23Wickebine^000000 in Morocc of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
and don't forget
the receipt!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
This is not a normal
Tsurugi! Look closely

^3355FFThe blade reads:
'Fine-edged
Geschupenschte
Tsurugi Special.'
It does seem to feel

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Anyway, take this
to ^8E6B23Krongast^000000 in Lighthalzen
and don't forget
the receipt!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
This is not a normal
Arbalest! Look closely
at the bow...

^3355FFThe bow reads:
Geschupenschte
Arbalest Luxury Edition.
It does seem more luxurious
than regular Arbalests.^000000

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Anyway, take this
to ^8E6B23Talpiz^000000 in Payon of Rune-Midgarts Kindgom,
and don't forget
the receipt!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
What's that look for?
This is not a normal
Ring Pommel Saber!
Look closely at
the handle...

^3355FFThe handle reads:
'Green Herbal
Ring Pommel Saber
of Geschupenschte
Mark 2.' It does seem
to have a completely
different feel.^000000

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: The power of Green Herbs, which is imbued in this sword, can be very useful! You can save someone from slowly dying of poison by stabbing them quickly with this weapon!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Anyway, take this
to ^8E6B23Bismarc^000000 in Hugel
and don't forget
the receipt!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
You still haven't
brought all the items.
Do you need to be reminded
or something? Bring me...

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Now, be sure to have
everything I need when
you come back. Remember,
this is a test! You can't
be a Blacksmith if you
slack off!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
What are you
still doing here?
Hurry and deliver
the package~!
Did you forget
where to go?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
In Geffen, at the
11 o'clock direction from the town center, you will find ^8E6B23Baisulist^000000. And don't forget the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Find the Swordmace
dealer ^8E6B23Wickebine^000000 in Morocc. And don't forget the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, 6 o'clock direction from the town center, you will find ^8E6B23Krongast^000000 near the weapon shop. And don't forget the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: In Payon, at the 5 o'clock direction from the town center, you will find ^8E6B23Talpiz^000000. And don't forget the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text: In Hugel, at the 1 o'clock direction from the town center, you will find ^8E6B23Bismarc^000000 near the airship. And don't forget the receipt.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmmm...?
Have you
completed
the delivery?
Let's see that receipt~
Yes sir, here it is.
Receipt? I, uh, have it somewhere.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Oh ho ho~
Great!
You're truly
a great Merchant!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Good job!
Return to ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000 in Einbroch, the guy you first met when you applied for the Blacksmith job.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
I have faith that you
will be a great Blacksmith!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
You mean...
You didn't get
a receipt?
What...?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
A receipt is
a Merchant's best friend!
It's necessary to your job!
You'll have to start your
test all over again!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Return when you
find the receipt~
You didn't forget
to receive a receipt.
Right...?

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Thank you
very much
your help.
Return to Einbroch
and see ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000!

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
You already finished
your test here with me!
And surprisingly, I don't
need any more help, today.

scripts.speaker: Geschupenschte
scripts.text:
Being
a Blacksmith
is truly great!
Don't you think so?
Mwahahahahah!!

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
Oh, hello!
Have you come
to deliver my
Arc Wand?

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
You sure this is what I ordered, right? I mean, if it's been used,
I don't want it.
Whoops, this is one of the items I use...
I'm sure! It's brand new!

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
Well...
I guess I can
wait a little longer.
Please hurry with
my delivery~

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
You're
absolutely sure?

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text: Thank you so much for traveling all the way here. That Geschupenschte, please smack him for me when you meet him for being so late on this order...

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
Please wait
a second, let
me give you a receipt~

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
Here it is.
Thank you so much!
Oh, and good luck~

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
Thank you
so much for
the delivery~

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
Oh...
It's been a while
since I've been
to Alberta.

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
I ordered something
from there a while ago,
but I haven't received
my delivery...

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
I wonder...
Could the Blacksmith Guild
be undermanned? I can't think of any other reason for them to be late...

scripts.speaker: Baisulist
scripts.text:
When will I get
my special Arc Wand?

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
...!
It's here!

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
This is what I ordered, right?
I don't want any used or old Gladius that you might have!
Whoops, not that one.
I guarantee you it is new.

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
Oooh...!
Hurry up
with my Gladius~
- She seems to be upset. -

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
Hah hah hah!
Finally! Now...
Let me have
a look!
- She looks very happy. -

scripts.text:
Are you with the
Einbroch Blacksmith Guild?

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
'^660000You're late!
Do you know how long

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
But, this is also
a masterfully crafted item.
Tell him I'm satisfied with the quality of the workmanship.

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
Here's the receipt.
I think you did
a good job.

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text: Thanks for the delivery.

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
They're late.
They're late,
they're late,
they're late~!

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text: How long does it take for something to ship from Geschupenschte? Usually, the Geffen Blacksmith Guild is pretty prompt...

scripts.speaker: Wickebine
scripts.text:
Ooohh...
This is very
upsetting...

scripts.speaker: Krongast
scripts.text:
Ohhhhhh~
Is it here?
Very nice.
Let me take a look.

scripts.speaker: Krongast
scripts.text:
So you're sure this is the item
I ordered, right? I wouldn't want it if it's been used.
Whoops, this one is used!
It was just made, so it's new.

scripts.speaker: Krongast
scripts.text:
Hmmmmm!
Please deliver
the right sword!
I've been waiting
long enough already...

scripts.speaker: Krongast
scripts.text:
You double checked?
Alright then, I'll take it!

scripts.speaker: Krongast
scripts.text:
Oh ho...
